func execute(scene_tree: SceneTree) -> Variant:
 scene_tree.root.disable_3d = true
 scene_tree.root.size = Vector2i(1280,900)
 var main = load("res://main.tscn").instantiate()
 main.prepare_initial_world = false
 main._settings_persistent = false
 main._force_touch = true
 scene_tree.root.add_child(main)
 main.set_process(false)
 var test = load("res://tests/service_ascent_input_case.gd").new()
 scene_tree.current_scene.set_meta("service_main",main)
 scene_tree.current_scene.set_meta("service_test",test)
 return test.begin(main)
